scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Every system has a purpose. But what happens when the system itself becomes the problem?

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: This is the Pathological Orange stage from Spiral Dynamics. It is when efficiency turns into exploitation.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The economic system was designed to create wealth. But it now creates inequality instead.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The rich get richer. The poor stay poor. The middle class disappears.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Wealth concentrates at the top. Resources flow upward, never trickling down.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The political system was designed to represent the people. But it represents the money.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Lobbyists write the laws. Corporations fund the campaigns. The people get the illusion of choice.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Privileges are distributed unequally. Justice depends on your bank account.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The wealthy get bailouts. The poor get sentences. The system protects itself.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Corruption is not a bug. It is a feature of a system designed by the powerful, for the powerful.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The justice system degrades. Laws become tools of oppression, not protection.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Regulatory capture means the regulators work for the regulated. The fox guards the henhouse.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Media consolidation means a few corporations control what you see, hear, and think.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Education becomes a commodity. Healthcare becomes a luxury. Housing becomes an investment.
